title: Welcome
check: The dark Blaze picture on the left, the welcome text mentions it works offline and that everything is included.

title: License
check: The license text (the Islamic Open Source License) reads as plain text with no stray marks. Next is disabled until you accept.

title: License accepted
check: I accept the agreement is selected and Next is enabled.

title: Choose where to install
check: A folder is suggested; the disk space needed is shown. No admin prompt appeared.

title: Additional tasks
check: Create a desktop shortcut is offered.

title: Ready to install
check: A summary of the choices; Install is the default button.

title: Installing
check: A progress bar moves; the small Blaze picture is at the top right.

title: Finished
check: Blaze is ready; Launch Blaze is ticked; the text says where videos are saved.

title: After Finish: the app starts
check: Blaze opens in your browser (a window or tab may be in front of this screen).
